searchText: Spec Sync #64 - <@243183686562873344> More opcode refactoring, inconsistency in minimum difficulty. - <@689161464829050960> Has a test that covers sufficient balance for gas but not for value, starting refactoring exceptions. - <@830368514225340436> getting support for the valid state tests, and improving spec rendering. <@243183686562873344> <@830368514225340436> I think we need to move to a development model with smaller pull requests. I'll get through the opcode refactoring one. In the future, and as an example, maybe we should've broken down this one into one PR to add the scaffolding, and one PR per opcode. I'm terrible at actually sitting down to do code reviews, and seeing 210 changed files is... discouraging. That's my failing though. I think that is partly due to the number of forks. The number of files is immediately 10xd Having said that, I agree with the idea of keeping the PRs small. Think the EVM refactor PR is an exception. Don’t see us implementing any PRs that massive going forward
